title: No tag for Hendrickson as time in Cincinnati ends

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: No tag for Hendrickson as time in Cincinnati ends
sources.description: The Bengals did not use the franchise tag on defensive end Trey Hendrickson ahead of Tuesday's 4 p.m. deadline, making the 2024 All-Pro edge rusher available to sign with another team when free agency opens next week.
